x: Len Bishop also coming into the team as a reserve, had the unenviable task of coping with Douglas of the Beagles and Ralph Dunkley of the Poly and although he drove himself to the last ounce, he was forced to give ground to this pair and to Porter of Finchley and we were once more back to fourth.
On the third leg Jim Radford had to give best to Poly's Ralph Dunkley (13:21) and Rooke of Essex Beagles (13:36) and handed over to Derek Crookes fourth.

Steadily he closed the gap on Ralph Dunkley of Poly and failed by only four seconds to make up the 49 sec. deficit with which he started. With the right training and more racing experience.Laurie could well become one of our leading runners within the next 12 months.
